title: The Lighter Brief
overview: A gentle mix today: Charlotte gets a crisp, sunny week that warms toward the 70s, Grammy nominations are rolling out, and Flo Rida helped fill Thanksgiving baskets in Miami Gardens. From Jamaica there's a proud honour roll, a debate over foreign policy, and an audit on hurricane relief heading to Parliament.

stories.headline: Charlotte: Chilly Mornings, Sunny Days, Warmer Weekend
stories.summary: The Carolinas are in for a dry, sunny week. Mornings start frosty, but afternoons are comfortable, and a warming trend kicks in Thursday. Next weekend looks mild and pleasant.
key_facts: Overnight lows in the 20s and 30s early in the week
Highs in the 60s Tuesday and Wednesday
Upper 60s to low 70s from Thursday through the weekend
stories.why: Keep the coat handy for mornings, but it's a great week for getting outside in the afternoons.

links.title: First Alert: Tracking a cold but sunny start to the week in the Carolinas

stories.headline: Hurricane Melissa Relief Audit Heads to Jamaica's Parliament
stories.summary: An Auditor General's report on how ODPEM and the Jamaica Constabulary Force handled donated goods after Hurricane Melissa is expected to be tabled in Parliament. It looks at whether controls were strong enough to prevent fraud and waste, including how donated Starlink devices were distributed.
key_facts: Report sent to Parliament on November 3 but not yet tabled
An earlier audit found only $26 million of $1.44 billion in cash donations (1.8%) had been spent on storm victims as of February 23, 2026
PM Holness says the government has spent about $84 billion on the overall response
stories.why: It's a public check on whether donations meant for hurricane survivors are being used well.

links.title: ODPEM, JCF under scrutiny in Melissa relief audit

stories.headline: Holness Pitches a 'Jamaica First' Foreign Policy
stories.summary: At the JLP's 83rd annual conference in Montego Bay, PM Andrew Holness said Jamaica won't be tied to any single ideological bloc. The speech comes amid debate over Jamaica abstaining on a UN resolution calling for an end to the US embargo on Cuba. He said foreign policy should deliver practical results like jobs, investment, and border security.
key_facts: Jamaica was one of three CARICOM countries to abstain on the October 28 UN vote
Trinidad and Tobago voted against the resolution
The US State Department praised the abstention; the opposition PNP has criticised the government's stance
stories.why: It signals how Jamaica plans to handle relationships with bigger powers going forward.

links.title: JAMAICA FIRST - No blind loyalty to foreign powers, Holness tells Labourites

stories.headline: Chinese Cars Are Catching On in Jamaica
stories.summary: China's ambassador, Wang Jinfeng, urged Chinese auto companies in Jamaica to hire and train more local engineers as their vehicles grow in popularity. A cut in import duties on newer electric vehicles has helped lower-priced Chinese EVs gain ground. He also pointed to solar power as a future area of cooperation.
key_facts: Import duty on EVs three years old or less was cut from 30% to 10%
Jamaica imported US$133.16 million in vehicles and auto equipment from China in 2025
Brands include BYD, GWM, MG, Changan and others
stories.why: More affordable EVs and potential local training jobs could be good news for Jamaican drivers and workers.

links.title: Wang calls for skills transfer as Chinese auto brands gain ground in Jamaica

stories.headline: Montego Bay Students Shine After a Tough Hurricane Year
stories.summary: Montego Bay Community College named 112 students to its 2026 Principal's Honour Roll and handed out 35 scholarships and bursaries. The ceremony's theme, 'Rebuilding Stronger,' marked the college's recovery from Hurricane Melissa.
key_facts: Top male student: Domar Hilton, IT, 3.70 GPA
Top female student: Kristen Jobson, pre-university science, 3.84 GPA
Lowell F. Hawthorne Foundation pledged US$8,000 to help affected students
stories.why: A lovely reminder that students kept excelling through a really disruptive year.

links.title: Hilton, Jobson lead MBCC’s 2026 academic honours

stories.headline: Matthews Holds Its First Pride in the Park
stories.summary: The town of Matthews, NC, hosted its first Pride in the Park at Stumptown Park, with 50 vendors, food trucks and live music. The event raised money for a local LGBTQ+ nonprofit. Some protesters showed up to oppose the event, and there were tense moments between the two groups.
key_facts: Held Sunday at Stumptown Park
Funds went to the Twirl to the World Foundation
Town Commissioner Brian Hacker called it a time for the community to come together
stories.why: It's a new community event in town, and the response shows it's a topic people locally feel strongly about.

links.title: First-ever Pride in the Park held at Stumptown Park in Matthews

stories.headline: Flo Rida Helps Feed Miami Gardens Families for Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Flo Rida backed his annual Thanksgiving food drive on November 14 at Studio 183 in Miami Gardens. Baskets with turkey, stuffing and more were meant to feed ten people each. He and his manager Freezy were also honored this fall in the Congressional Record for their community work.
key_facts: Law firm Kelley | Uustal is supporting for a third straight year
Rep. Frederica Wilson's tribute was entered October 6
The pair co-founded Big Dreams for Kids, offering youth sports programs
disputed: Confirmed through partner announcements and local reporting; no disputes noted
stories.why: A warm holiday story about a star giving back to his hometown community.

links.title: Flo Rida Backs Thanksgiving Food Drive For Miami Gardens Families

stories.headline: Study Links Breastfeeding With Fewer Depressive Symptoms in Moms
stories.summary: Researchers at the University of Sharjah looked at breastfeeding and maternal depressive symptoms in low- and middle-income countries in Africa and South Asia. They found breastfeeding was associated with fewer symptoms.
key_facts: Published in Discover Mental Health
Focused on selected countries in Africa and South Asia
disputed: This shows an association, not proof that breastfeeding causes better mood
Only a brief summary was available, so study size and methods aren't detailed here
stories.why: It adds to research on supporting new mothers' mental health.

links.title: Breastfeeding is associated with fewer maternal depressive symptoms, study finds
